articles.title: Train fare hike December 26: Check new ticket prices for Delhi–Mumbai and Delhi–Howrah routes
articles.summary: Indian Railways is implementing a nationwide fare hike starting Friday, December 26, making train journeys across India more expensive for passengers. This marks the second fare increase, impacting all classes and routes. The decision aims to address rising operational costs and fund crucial infrastructure development, potentially affecting daily commuters and long-distance travellers nationwide.

Researchers observed various unique creatures, including an unusual octopus and an alien-like Antarctic dweller, offering unprecedented close looks. These discoveries expand our understanding of marine biodiversity and the unexplored depths, highlighting ongoing scientific exploration crucial for global ecological knowledge.

articles.title: China says US arms sales to Taiwan 'speeding up threat of war'
articles.summary: The US approved substantial arms sales on December 18, comprising eight key defence items. This package includes advanced HIMARS rocket systems, howitzers, Javelin anti-tank missiles, and Altius loitering munition drones, along with spare parts. This move strengthens military capabilities and underscores ongoing international strategic arms procurement efforts.

articles.summary: Recent data indicates a strong 30% growth in Indian students enrolling for studies abroad. articles.title: INDIAN COAST GUARD INDUCTS ITS FIRST POLLUTION CONTROL VESSEL - YARD 1267 SAMUDRA PRATAP- CONSTRUCTED AT GOA SHIPYARD LTD
articles.summary: The Indian Coast Guard (ICG), operating under the Ministry of Defence, has inducted its first in-built Pollution Control Vessel (PCV), named SAMUDRA PRA.... This significant addition boosts India's maritime capabilities to effectively respond to oil spills and other environmental emergencies. The new PCV strengthens the ICG's critical role in safeguarding marine ecosystems and national maritime interests within Indian waters.
